resources.string: Shigar ranar Hijiriyya don samun Arafah, An-Nahr da Tashriq
Shigar da kwanan watan Hijiriyya don ganin ranakun Arafah, An-Nahr da Tashriq
Shigar da ingantaccen kwanan watan Hijira. Shekara daga 1300 zuwa 1600, wata daga 1 zuwa 12, rana daga 1 zuwa 30.

Shiga kowace Hijriya (ko ajiye kwanan watan) don samun kwanakin Hajjin shekararsa nan take: Ranar Arafah (9 Zul-Hijjah), Ranar An-Nahr (10 Zul-Hijjah) da Ranakun Tashriq (11, 12 da 13 Dhul-Hijjah), kowanne da kwatankwacinsa na Miladiya da matsayinsa dangane da kwanan watan.
Babban ginshiƙi: Tsayuwa a Arafah daga bayan la\'asar har zuwa faduwar rana, kuna yawaita addu\'a da takbir da tahli. Manzon Allah (SAW) ya ce: “Hajji Arafah ce”.
Eid al-Adha: jifan Jamarat al-Aqabah da tsakuwa guda bakwai, a yi layya, aski ko a datse, sannan a yi Tawaf al-Ifadah da Sai.
Sanarwa ta yau da kullun tana tunatar da ku abubuwan da aka yi niyya a lokacin aikin Hajji (8-13 Dhul-Hijjah)

Sunnar wannan rana: ku shiga ihrami, ku nufi Mina, ku kwana a can, kuna maimaita Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", sannan a yi addu\'a a wurin a takaice ba tare da hadawa ba.
Jifa Jamarat uku bayan la\'asar: Karama, sannan na tsakiya, sai babba, tsakuwa guda bakwai kowanne a lokacin da suke takbir, suna addu\'a bayan kanana da na tsakiya.
Maimaita jifan Jamarat uku bayan la\'asar kamar jiya. Wanda ya so yin gaggawa ya bar Mina kafin faduwar rana; wanda ya zauna ya kwana ya yi jifa a rana ta uku.
Jifa Jamarat uku bayan la\'asar, sannan a kammala aikin Hajji da Tawafin bankwana idan an tashi daga Makkah. Allah ya karbi Hajjin ku.

Cikakken bayanin aikin Hajji da Umra: ma’ana da hukunce-hukunce, nau’ukan ibadodi, mawaqit, ibadodi mataki-mataki da hikimominsu da abin da za a fada a kowace tasha, da haramcin ihrami, da addu’o’i. Zaɓi ɓangaren da kuke son bincika.
